subject: Proposed kickoff windows + attendee rollcall and call room links
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@dataforge.com>, implementations@dataforge.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed kickoff windows + attendee rollcall and call room links

Hi Jordan + DataForge team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're ready to lock in the customer kickoff so engineering and CS can hand off and get implementation scheduled. Two quick asks up front:

1) Please confirm preferred kickoff window from the three options below (times shown in PT / ET / UTC). Pick all that work and note any mandatory attendees.
   - Option A: Wed Mar 24, 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 17:00 UTC (90 min)
   - Option B: Wed Mar 24, 13:00 PT / 16:00 ET / 20:00 UTC (90 min)
   - Option C: Thu Mar 25, 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 15:00 UTC (60 min — focused tech onboarding)

2) Rollcall: who from DataForge will attend for each bucket (product, infra, security, procurement). We'll map roles to agenda items.

Proposed agenda (draft, attached deck):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives (CS + Customer exec sponsor)
- 10–35m: Architecture overview & data paths (Customer infra + Redwood infra lead)
- 35–60m: Implementation plan & responsibilities (Mutual action plan review)
- 60–75m: Prework & access checklist (VPN, VPC peering, KMS)
- 75–90m: Next steps, owners, dates

Attachments: kickoff_deck_v0.pptx (attached), draft SOW referenced is DF_SOW_v1.pdf in the shared folder.

Technical prework notes for your infra lead: please ensure at least one person has admin rights to your cloud project and that we have a small test dataset (anonymized) available for the first integration test — details are on slide 8.

When you confirm a window I will send the calendar invite with a Zoom link and Zoom breakout rooms pre-provisioned; we can also provide a Webex link if you prefer. Quick note on recording: we'll record the session for internal alignment unless you request otherwise.

Calendar poll (if you prefer to self-select): https://doodle.com/poll/redwood-dataforge-kickoff
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-kickoff-pack

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

[Attachment: kickoff_deck_v0.pptx (pptx, 12 slides)]
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@dataforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: implementations@dataforge.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff windows + attendee rollcall and call room links

Thanks Vivek —

Option A and Option C both look workable; Option B collides with our leadership all-hands. For clarity, here's our proposed rollcall per area:
- Product: Jordan Ellis (me, PM) + Maya Singh (product ops)
- Infra: Sam Reddy <sam.reddy@dataforge.com> (platform eng)
- Security: Angela Cortez <angela.cortez@dataforge.com> (security lead)
- Procurement: procurement@dataforge.com (copying procurement alias)

We'd prefer Option A if Sam can make it — it gives enough time. Also please provision a Webex link; our infra team uses Webex internally and we have a corporate policy around Zoom recordings.

One more ask: can you add a short 'networking requirements' checklist into the calendar invite (ports, IP ranges)? That will help our infra folks triage before the meeting.

On the SOW: our legal has a couple of small questions but nothing blocking for kickoff — we'll share redlines after the session.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
DataForge — Senior Product Manager
jordan.ellis@dataforge.com | +1 617-555-0099

Vivek: I can lead the mutual action plan review and Ben will cover the infra checklist and run the test dataset walkthrough. Monica will be on the agenda to review onboarding milestones and customer success metrics. Proposed internal owners:
- Implementation plan & MAP: laura.bennett (owner)
- Infra validation & test dataset: ben.carter (owner)
- Access/permissions checklist: monica.patel (owner)

Jordan — adding the explicit network/IP checklist to the calendar invite now (I'll paste it into the event description). Also switching the meeting room to Webex per your note and we'll avoid enabling recording unless you ask.

Attachments: DF_SOW_v1.pdf (attached) — I highlighted the operational kickoff milestone on page 3.

Proposed final: Lock Option A (Wed Mar 24, 10:00 PT). I will send the invite for that slot unless someone objects within 12 hours.
